Compute Cumulative Walkable Accessibility to Points of Interest (POIs)

Source: R/access.R
walk_compute_access.Rd

Computes cumulative pedestrian accessibility from each network junction to urban facilities (e.g. schools, health centers, pharmacies, public transit stops) within a walking time budget (default 10 minutes at 4.5 km/h). Uses parallel compiled Rust to evaluate hundreds of thousands of shortest paths across CPU cores.

Usage

walk_compute_access(
  network,
  pois,
  time_min = 10,
  category_col = NULL,
  weight_col = NULL,
  target = c("largest_component", "all"),
  n_threads = 0,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

network

A walk_network object produced by walk_build_network().

pois

An sf points collection containing destination facilities/POIs.

time_min

Walking time threshold in minutes (default 10.0 minutes).

category_col

Optional column name in pois indicating facility category (e.g. "amenity", "category", or "type"). If provided, calculates separate accessibility counts for each unique category.

weight_col

Optional column name in pois indicating facility weight/capacity. Default is NULL (each POI counts as 1.0).

target

Character string: "largest_component" (default) to evaluate nodes in the primary connected component, or "all".

n_threads

Number of CPU threads (0 = auto-detect all available cores).

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints execution progress and summary.

Value

A walk_access S3 object containing:

nodes

sf points table augmented with columns for cumulative counts and minimum walking times.

summary

Summary statistics table per category.

time_min

The evaluated walking budget in minutes.

pois

The original POI points mapped to network nodes.

network

The input walk_network.

Examples

data(streets_cusco)
net <- walk_build_network(streets_cusco, verbose = FALSE)
sample_pois <- net$nodes[net$nodes$is_giant, ][seq(1, 100, by = 20), ]
acc <- walk_compute_access(net, pois = sample_pois, time_min = 5, verbose = FALSE)
print(acc)
#> 
#> ── Walkability Cumulative POI Accessibility ────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Isochrone Threshold: 5.0 minutes
#> ✔ Facilities Evaluated: 5
#> ✔ Evaluated Junctions: 249
#> • [all_pois] Avg reachable: 0.6 | Max: 2 | Reachability coverage: 50.2% of
#>   network
